result.rationale: The migration does `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i` with no check for empty result. Site settings rows typically only exist when explicitly set (default is ''), so on most installations the query returns 0 rows and `[0]` is nil, raising NoMethodError and aborting the migration.

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration does `category_id = execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i`. If that SELECT returns zero rows (e.g., `embed_category` setting absent/blank or value doesn’t match any `categories.name`), `execute(...)[0]` is `nil` and `nil['id']` raises NoMethodError before the later `if category_id == 0` fallback can run, aborting the migration.
